question: On the bank of which river was Harappa Civilisation situated?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Ravi River**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The Harappan Civilization was located on the banks of the Ravi River in the Punjab region of Pakistan: 
 
• The Indus Valley Civilization, also known as the Harappan Civilization, was a Bronze Age civilization that spanned from 3300 BCE to 1300 BCE.
 
• The civilization flourished along the Indus River and the Ghaggar-Hakra river system.
 
• The Indus Valley Civilization was one of the three early civilizations of the Near East and South Asia, along with ancient Egypt and Mesopotamia. 
 
• The Archaeological Survey of India excavated the mounds at Harappa between 1920 and 1934.
 
• The discovery of Harappa, along with Mohenjo-daro, was the result of work that began after the founding of the Archaeological Survey of India in 1861.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Bhogwa River: The ancient city of Lothal is located on the Bhogwa River. 
 
• Sindhu River: Also known as the Indus River, this river flows through India, Pakistan, and China.
 
 
• The Indus River originates from the Bokharchu glacier near Manasarovar Lake in Tibet.
 
• The Indus Valley site Mohenjo-daro is located on the banks of the Indus River. 
 
 
 
• Sutlej River:
 
 
• The Sutlej River is the longest tributary of the Indus River in India.
 
• It originates from Lake La'nga in southwestern Tibet and flows through Himachal Pradesh and Punjab.
 
• The Sutlej River forms 65 miles of the India-Pakistan border before joining the Chenab River.
 
• The Bhakra Dam is built on the Sutlej River to provide irrigation and other facilities to the states of Punjab, Rajasthan, and Haryana.
